validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <transition/>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: transition must have at least one of `event`, `cond`, or `target`

primary.message: transition has no trigger, guard, or target

notes: SCXML 1.0 §3.5.2: "A conformant SCXML document MUST specify at least one of 'event', 'cond' or 'target'." Executable content alone does not count: such a transition is enabled in every microstep and never changes the configuration, so the macrostep would never complete
diagnostics.help: add the event that triggers it, a condition, or the target state

fixes.message: add the event that triggers the transition
